title: ai4s-research/open-science
claim: ai4s-research/open-science — Open Science Desktop: a local-first, model-agnostic AI research workbench for macOS, Windows and Linux.
hook: A local-first, bring-your-own-model research workbench — the open Claude-for-Science that keeps your data on your machine.
why_good: A local-first, model-agnostic AI research workbench (Tauri + MCP + agent skills) that runs the whole loop — exploration, literature survey, hypothesis, experiment code, analysis, figures, write-up — in one auditable, reproducible desktop session; it can even drive your own Chrome and be read from your phone.
value: Buyer: universities, biotech and R&D teams under data-governance constraints. Money: lab/team licenses and a hosted collaboration tier.
risk: Research tooling monetizes slowly and grant-funded users are price-sensitive; a local agent desktop is also a shell the model labs could ship themselves. The benchmark lead is real but weeks old — watch whether it holds as tasks get harder.

zh.claim: ai4s-research/open-science —— Open Science Desktop:本地优先、模型无关的 AI 科研工作台,支持 macOS/Windows/Linux。
zh.hook: 本地优先、自带模型的科研工作台——把数据留在本机的开源版「Claude for Science」。
zh.why_good: 一个本地优先、模型无关的 AI 科研工作台(Tauri + MCP + agent 技能),把科研全流程——探索、文献综述、假设、实验代码、分析、作图、成文——跑在一个可审计、可复现的桌面会话里;还能驱动你自己的 Chrome,并从手机上查看。
zh.value: 买家:受数据合规约束的大学、生物科技和研发团队。变现:实验室/团队授权和托管协作版。
zh.risk: 科研工具变现慢,靠经费的用户对价格敏感;而『本地 agent 桌面』这层壳,模型厂商自己也能做。基准领先是真的但才几周——看它在更难任务上能不能守住。
zh.does: 一个本地优先、模型无关的 AI 科研工作台(Tauri + MCP + agent 技能),把科研全流程——探索、文献综述、假设、实验代码、分析、作图、成文——跑在一个可审计、可复现的桌面会话里;还能驱动你自己的 Chrome,并从手机上查看。
zh.edge: 它在 ResearchClawBench(自主科研 agent 的端到端 Pass@1 基准)上排第一,同时把数据留在本地、不绑定单一厂商——『有实测能力』又『私有』的组合很少见。
zh.why_use: 适合想要 agent 帮忙、但不愿上传未发表数据、也不想被单一模型锁死的实验室、生物科技和科研团队——可复现、可内网部署的 AI 科研。

does: A local-first, model-agnostic AI research workbench (Tauri + MCP + agent skills) that runs the whole loop — exploration, literature survey, hypothesis, experiment code, analysis, figures, write-up — in one auditable, reproducible desktop session; it can even drive your own Chrome and be read from your phone.
edge: It ranks #1 on ResearchClawBench (a Pass@1 end-to-end benchmark for autonomous science agents) while keeping data local and vendor-agnostic — a rare mix of measured capability and privacy.
why_use: For labs, biotech and research teams that want agentic help without uploading unpublished data or locking into one model — reproducible, on-prem AI research.
